svg.text: N3C DATA GOVERNANCE AND COMPLIANCE WORKFLOW

text.tspan: Multi-level and multiple groups of accountability ensure that both sites (Institutional Agreements) and researchers
(Individual and PIs) formally commit to ethical and legal compliance prior to any data access. These are legally
binding agreements. The follow workflow presents the three pathways for dynamic workspaces to be provisioned,
highlighting any potential risks and how those risks are managed and mitigated through the rigorous N3C governance process.

The DAR Review Committee leverages Subject Matter Experts to assess researcher proposals and the
alignment of phenotype codes with the research question. The Review committee provides its feedback, in
an iterative process with researchers and all feedback/mitigations are combined with the DAR submission
and the site selected governance structure is executed.
